# Hornero OS

> HorneroOS is an Arch-based operating-system family. Its current preview is a Wayland-first desktop powered by Hornero Shell; Hyprland is the supported default compositor and Niri is experimental.

## Status

HorneroOS is pre-release. Desktop, Studio and Gaming Preview install from the signed v0.2.0-preview31 ISO (one x86_64 image, VM-validated; see https://www.horneroos.com/install). The Desktop is also available as Arch packages for existing Arch systems. Server and Agents are defined as composable editions with planned maturity and no installable image.

The default language is Spanish (Argentina); English lives under /en/.
